subject: Re: Kickoff: abbreviation-aware normalization — May status + coverage risk
body:
Hi both,

Status: pipeline milestone hit. survey.tsv parses cleanly into per-locale feature vectors; we track consultant proficiency (column 3) as a confidence weight, which noticeably de-noises the rule baselines.

Efe's baselines cover 27 locales so far. Truncations and first-character abbreviations are well-attested nearly everywhere; the thin spots are augmented truncations and word-internal deletions, where several locales have a Yes flag but only one or two consultant examples to learn from.

Risk: for roughly 8 of the 27 locales we have a single consultant response. Fine-grained rules learned from one person's examples will overfit — Umar suggests grouping those locales by script family in the July sweep rather than giving them dedicated heads. Costs some per-locale precision, protects generalization.

Locale list from Priya received, sweep config is keyed to it.

Nikhil
